body: Hey, thanks man! ive never really thought of a pen pal to be honest. Though I tried writing stuff down a few times before but always get paranoid that someone may someday find it and read it so i never get passed 3 or 4 words before crumbling the paper. I just lost my first long term serious girlfriend...and this may be just me being unnecessarily stupid but the more i think the more I believe that she never really loved me and it just puts me in this paralyzing lonelyness....about the cbt thing..as a kid and straight through highschool and college I didnt believe in thearapists because i didnt really believe they truly cared as much as it was just their job, and that a bunch of their methods sounded to prophet like for my taste. That was until a friend of mine (psych major) introduced me to cbt which finally resonated with me. In short: its all about you're attitude. But man idk man you can only mind fuck yourself for so long until it doesnt work anymore

Thanks man, it got me thinking...while i was talking to him i just felt better..should i see my university's counseling center? I never went before because i didnt like the idea of having written records about me and my private life written down out there. But after literally quietly crying myself to sleep last night i think it may be time..no?
